---
title: Send, wait 5 days, remind again, and copy the CRA from the second reminder
performer: system
strictness: strict
reads: [case.site, case.email_to, case.email_cc, case.email_subject, case.email_body]
tools:
  allowed:  [etmf.reminder.create]
  required: [etmf.reminder.create]
map:
  etmf.reminder.create:
    site:    case.site
    sent_to: case.email_to
    copied:  case.email_cc
    subject: case.email_subject
    body:    case.email_body
    sent_at: { now: true }
outcomes: [sent]
---
Send the approved reminder to the site and keep it on the site's record, so the next round knows how
many reminders came before. Then the site has 5 days to upload; the next reminder goes out unless
the start-up pack is complete by then.

input.summary: Copy the CRA on the reminder from the second one on

reply:
Done: from the second reminder on, the reminder is sent to the site coordinator **and copies the site's CRA**. It's in a draft; the live playbook hasn't changed.

I ran the draft on **site 104** in a throwaway copy: it found 3 missing documents, drafted the reminder, and would record it as sent to the coordinator, copying Priya Shah (the CRA). Nothing was sent.

When you're happy with it, use **Send for review** on the page.
2 sites still owe documents: **FR-201** (6 missing) and **DE-104** (3 missing). The list beside this chat now shows just those two; save it as a page to keep it.

The test run copied site 104, its study and its expected documents into a throwaway database and replayed the latest chase's model turns. It stopped at **Wait for the upload**, where the next reminder waits 5 days.
Ask me to change the playbook, or to filter the list, and I'll do it here.
